title: 雞寮半暝 Ke-liâu Puànn-mê
mood: sweaty, rowdy and racing the clock
subject: a Yunlin chicken-catching crew (掠雞班) of seven racing to load 400 crates from a 6,000-bird broiler house before driver A-tsai's lorry has to leave at five for its slaughterhouse slot, while foreman A-gi stands on the lorry roof with his torch and calls every crate like a variety-show emcee, bringing on Auntie Tsu with four birds a hand without looking and the Su brothers stacking crates eight high as A-tsai checks his watch and honks; with fifty crates and ten minutes to go A-gi jumps down to catch too, and the 400th crate goes up on time while the rooster in the next village is only just crowing
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien Brazilian funk carioca on a classic tamborzão beat. A dry programmed baile-funk tamborzão drum loop with a booming 808 kick and slapping atabaque-style hand-drum hits; a deep sub-bass pulse locked to the kick; short, bright brass-synth stabs at the end of each phrase; a sports whistle blasting on the hooks. Hot, loud, punchy party mix with the voice up front. A brash young male lead in a half-sung, half-chanted rhythmic delivery, answered by a gang chant of mixed voices on the hook. 130 BPM, G minor. Sweaty, rowdy and racing the clock. No trap hi-hats, no reggaeton dembow, no autotune, no EDM drop, no phonk cowbell, no funk-rock guitar.
lyrics:
[Verse]
雲林庄跤 半暝兩點半
六千隻雞 睏甲恬恬
七个人 喙罨掛好 雨鞋穿好
大卡車 倒退 靠佇雞寮門口

[Pre-Chorus]
工頭阿義 蹈起去卡車頂
手電仔一下照落來 各位觀眾 開工矣

[Chorus]
雞寮半暝 拚四百籠
雞跤 夾佇指頭仔縫
雞籠 一籠一籠 捒上車
阿義喝 噗仔聲催落去

[Verse]
第一位出場 阿珠姨
一手四隻 看都無看
第二組 蘇家兩兄弟
籠仔 疊甲八層懸

[Pre-Chorus]
司機阿財 一直看手錶
五點出車 晏一分都袂使

[Chorus]
雞寮半暝 拚四百籠
雞毛 黏佇目睫毛
阿財的喇叭 揤袂停
阿義喝 較緊 催落去

[Verse]
四點半 阿義徛佇卡車頂
逐籠攏喝 喝甲若秀場的主持人
各位觀眾 第三百籠
規班的人 衫仔澹甲會滴水

[Bridge]
閣五十籠 閣十分鐘
雞仔 一隻一隻 精神矣
阿義 跳落卡車 家己嘛落去掠

[Chorus]
雞寮半暝 贏過阿財的錶
第四百籠 上尾一籠 疊起去
阿財的車 五點準時開出去
各位觀眾 噗仔聲催落去

[Outro]
隔壁庄的雞公 這馬才咧啼
